location.site_description: Outside Odessa in Ector County; Ector CAD parcel 46960.00010.00000 is listed at E LOOP 338, Odessa 79766 and owned by Texas Critical Data Centers LLC.

why_not_in_baseline: Not among the 208 canonical_project names; after-freeze Ector County AI/HPC campus now owned by New Era Energy & Digital, with public-company disclosures showing Ector County site control, development/permitting workstreams, and a phased capacity target of up to 1.4 GW.

contradictions.issue: Acreage varies by source and transaction status.
contradictions.detail: Ector CAD currently exposes a 205.13-acre TCDC-owned parcel at E LOOP 338. Company releases and SEC materials describe 438 acres owned after the 203-acre acquisition, plus a 54-acre corridor LOI/definitive agreement that would bring the campus footprint to 492 acres. The public site markets 492 acres.

contradictions.issue: Capacity is a target, not delivered or energized capacity.
contradictions.detail: Earlier disclosures used 1+ GW and 250 MW initial/behind-the-meter references. Current company site and May 2026 investor materials describe phased 200 MW, +450 MW, and +750 MW capacity toward a 1.4+ GW campus.

history.reason: Aligned to company, SEC, and county-appraisal naming for Texas Critical Data Centers LLC/TCDC.

history.old: Sharon AI and New Era Energy & Digital
history.reason: New Era's January 2026 Form 8-K says it completed acquisition of SharonAI's equity interests in TCDC.
Updated from 1 GW target to current company/SEC 1.4 GW phased target; this remains planned capacity, not operating capacity.

history.old: phase two site planning; behind-the-meter power agreements; large-load interconnection application planned
history.reason: Normalized to SKILL.md taxonomy. Evidence supports land ownership, development/permitting workstreams, early site preparation, financing, and power/interconnection planning, but no verified permit approval or construction start was found.
